proposals.evidence: Qualified reflexes of the loṭ-/luṭ- roll/lie family plus the gay- gone auxiliary. Turner *lōrtati explicitly includes Pk loṭṭai rolls/sleeps and luṭṭai sleeps, with the unaspirated regional loṭ- series and Oriya noṭ- variant. The western survey geminates and n-initial variants are compared with this family without claiming that the Oriya variant is their immediate ancestor. Both constituents are included; extra hū/hūi auxiliary clauses are excluded.

proposals.evidence: The complete imperative consists of roll/lie down + go. The first member is compared with Turner *lōrtati (Pk loṭṭai/luṭṭai sleep; regional loṭ- and n-initial noṭ-); the second is jā-/jo go from yāti. The n-initial western forms are qualified comparative members of this family, preserving the source spelling rather than asserting a direct Oriya borrowing.
